title: Editable email template bodies
summary: Admins can now rewrite the whole body of an email template, with merge fields such as the recipient's name, a preview and a reset.
changes: Add an Email body field to each editable email template in Admin.
Bodies can use merge fields, such as the recipient's name and the ticket number, which are filled in when the email is sent.
The greeting, button, footer and no-reply address stay on edited emails.
Preview shows the edited body, and Reset returns to the standard email.
Bodies are cleaned before saving and each change is recorded in the audit log.
version_rationale: Patch: adds one nullable column and an optional body override to the existing email copy editor.
validation: New feature test for saving a body, the sent email, merge fields, unknown fields, preview and reset.
Full PHPUnit suite and the MySQL contract job in CI.
known_limitations: Merge fields are limited to the recipient's name, the app name and the values in the template's subject and opening line.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Saved bodies are then ignored and emails use the standard wording.
provenance: Milestone v0.50.2 Beta, issue #486 under epic #481, pull request #622.
